tasks.title: Define ClassificationSource interface as internal seam for SDK injection
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/main/java/com/shomer/client/data/ClassificationSource.kt with the ClassificationSource interface (classifyText, classifyImage, health suspend functions). ChildClassifyViewModel must depend only on this interface, not on ShomerClient directly. Production wiring binds ShomerClientAdapter; tests inject FakeClassificationSource. This follows the user directive for strong OOP isolation.
acceptance_criteria: ClassificationSource interface exists with 3 suspend methods matching ShomerClient signatures
ChildClassifyViewModel compiles with ClassificationSource as its only dependency (not ShomerClient)
ShomerClientAdapter implements ClassificationSource
FakeClassificationSource can be created in test files with 5 lines of code

tasks.title: Define Android client config via DataStore and BuildConfig keys
tasks.description: Document all 8 config values from the LLD in the SettingsRepository DataStore: serverUrl, connectTimeoutMs, readTimeoutMs, imageReadTimeoutMs, imageMaxEdgePx, imageJpegQuality, fcmSenderId, alertRetentionDays. BuildConfig keys provide defaults; DataStore overrides at runtime for user-editable settings (serverUrl only). Ensure google-services.json is in app/src/parent/ and gitignored.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 config values documented with defaults in SettingsRepository or BuildConfig
serverUrl is DataStore-persisted and user-editable via SettingsScreen
Other values are BuildConfig constants (not user-editable at runtime)
google-services.json path is documented in README; .gitignore excludes it

tasks.title: Wire Timber logger with structured JSON release tree and shomer.<module> tag pattern
tasks.description: Configure Timber in MainActivity.onCreate(): DebugTree for debug builds, a custom JsonTree for release builds that emits JSON with trace_id, module, event, flavor fields. Implement the three documented log events: classify_success, classify_success (context_used=true), classify_error (NetworkError). Logger tag pattern: shomer.child.classify, shomer.parent.dashboard, shomer.fcm.
acceptance_criteria: Timber.DebugTree planted in debug builds only
Release build log events include: trace_id, module, event, flavor
classify_success event includes: label, confidence, latency_ms
classify_error event includes: error_type, message
No request text content is logged (privacy)

tasks.title: Define Android performance metrics with AtomicLong counters and Firebase traces
tasks.description: Implement all 5 Android metrics from the LLD: shomer_android_classify_total (AtomicLong counter), shomer_android_classify_latency_ms (Firebase Performance trace), shomer_android_network_error_total (AtomicLong counter), shomer_android_fcm_received_total (AtomicLong counter, parent flavor only), shomer_android_image_compress_ms (Firebase Performance trace). Wire into ChildClassifyViewModel and ShomerFcmService.
acceptance_criteria: shomer_android_classify_total increments on every classify call with flavor and input_type labels
shomer_android_classify_latency_ms trace covers the full SDK call duration
shomer_android_image_compress_ms trace is started before compress and stopped after
shomer_android_fcm_received_total increments in ShomerFcmService.onMessageReceived()

tasks.title: Configure product flavors (child vs parent) with separate applicationIds and manifests
tasks.description: Configure android_client/app/build.gradle with two product flavors: child (applicationId com.shomer.child) and parent (applicationId com.shomer.parent). Create separate manifest entries: parent manifest requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS and includes FCM service; child manifest requests CAMERA. Separate src/child/ and src/parent/ source sets with flavor-specific entry points.
acceptance_criteria: gradle build produces app-child-release.apk and app-parent-release.apk as separate artifacts
child applicationId is com.shomer.child; parent is com.shomer.parent
Parent manifest includes android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS and FCM service declaration
Child manifest includes android.permission.CAMERA; does not include FCM service
Parent flavor APK does not contain ChildClassifyScreen code; child APK does not contain DashboardScreen code

tasks.title: Implement Hilt AppModule providing ShomerClient and binding ClassificationSource
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/main/java/com/shomer/client/di/AppModule.kt as a Hilt @Module. Provide: ShomerClient built from SettingsRepository.serverUrl; ShomerClientAdapter binding ClassificationSource to ShomerClient; AlertRepository as a singleton. Wire Hilt into MainApplication. The DI module is the only place that knows about ShomerClient (ViewModels see only interfaces).
acceptance_criteria: AppModule.kt provides ShomerClient, ClassificationSource, AlertRepository
ChildClassifyViewModel receives ClassificationSource (not ShomerClient) via @Inject
ShomerClient is a singleton (not recreated on ViewModel recreation)
Hilt application component initializes without errors on app startup

tasks.title: Implement ChildClassifyViewModel with image compression and SDK calls
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/child/java/com/shomer/client/viewmodel/ChildClassifyViewModel.kt. Implement classifyText() and classifyImage(): loadAndCompress(uri) -> ByteArray (max 1600px, JPEG 80), call ClassificationSource.classifyText/classifyImage, map ShomerResult to ChildUiState. Emit SuccessText, SuccessImage, Loading, Idle, Error states. Wire metrics.
acceptance_criteria: classifyImage(uri) compresses image to max 1600px edge, JPEG quality 80 before SDK call
ShomerResult.Success -> ChildUiState.SuccessText or SuccessImage with correct ClassificationResult
ShomerResult.Failure(NetworkError) -> ChildUiState.Error('Cannot reach server')
Loading state emitted before SDK call; final state emitted after
Image compression runs on IO dispatcher (not Main)

tasks.title: Implement ShomerFcmService to receive push alerts and write to Room
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/parent/java/com/shomer/client/service/ShomerFcmService.kt extending FirebaseMessagingService. onMessageReceived(): deserialize FCM data payload to AlertItem; call alertDao.insert(); show system notification via NotificationCompat. onNewToken(): write new FCM token to DataStore (SettingsRepository.fcmToken). Malformed payload must be logged and skipped without crashing.
acceptance_criteria: onMessageReceived() deserializes FCM data payload to AlertItem using the documented JSON field names
AlertItem is inserted into Room alerts table
System notification is shown with correct title and body
Malformed JSON payload: log warning, skip insert, no crash
onNewToken() writes new token to SettingsRepository DataStore

tasks.title: Implement ParentDashboardViewModel reading from Room AlertRepository
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/parent/java/com/shomer/client/viewmodel/ParentDashboardViewModel.kt. State: Flow<DashboardUiState> from Room AlertRepository. refresh() calls ClassificationSource.health(). dismissAlert(id) calls alertDao.dismiss(). When Room emits a new row (FCM insert), DashboardScreen recomposes automatically. Wire alertRetentionDays purge via AlertRepository.purgeOldDismissed() on init.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardUiState.Ready(alerts, serverHealthy) emitted after successful health check
New FCM-inserted Row in Room causes StateFlow to emit updated Ready state
dismissAlert(id) sets dismissedAt timestamp in Room
purgeOldDismissed() removes rows where dismissedAt < (now - 7 days) on ViewModel init
DashboardUiState.Error emitted when server health check fails

tasks.title: Implement DashboardScreen, HistoryScreen, and AlertDetailScreen Composables (parent flavor)
tasks.description: Create the three new parent-flavor Composable screens: DashboardScreen (alert list with review badge), HistoryScreen (paginated AlertItem list), AlertDetailScreen (full explanation, quote, contextUsed badge). All screens are stateless Composables taking UiState + intent lambdas from ParentDashboardViewModel. Include the 'Needs Human Review' yellow badge for reviewFlag=true alerts.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardScreen renders a LazyColumn of AlertItem cards
AlertItem card with reviewFlag=true shows a yellow 'Needs Human Review' badge
AlertDetailScreen shows: label, severity, explanation, quote, contextUsed indicator
All screens are @Composable functions with no business logic
HistoryScreen uses paging (at minimum a simple offset query)

tasks.title: Implement SettingsViewModel and wire SettingsScreen to SDK test connection
tasks.description: Create android_client/app/src/main/java/com/shomer/client/viewmodel/SettingsViewModel.kt. Expose SettingsUiState(serverUrl, connectionStatus). Implement: updateServerUrl() updates in-memory state, save() persists to DataStore, testConnection() calls ClassificationSource.health() and maps result to ConnectionStatus enum (Untested, Testing, Ok, Failed).
acceptance_criteria: testConnection() emits ConnectionStatus.Testing then Ok or Failed
save() persists serverUrl to DataStore; new ShomerClient is built from new URL
SettingsScreen displays the ConnectionStatus with appropriate visual indicator
Existing SettingsScreen.kt is wired to the new SettingsViewModel (replaces direct SettingsRepository usage)

tasks.title: Implement Android offline mode, permission denial UX, and image decode failure fallbacks
tasks.description: Implement all failure modes from LLD §8: server unreachable -> ChildUiState.Error + parent 'Server offline' banner; CAMERA permission denied -> show rationale dialog, disable camera button; corrupt image decode -> ChildUiState.Error('Could not decode image'); FCM malformed payload -> log warning, skip insert. Ensure no crashes on any of these paths.
acceptance_criteria: ShomerError.NetworkError -> ChildUiState.Error('Cannot reach server') with no crash
CAMERA permission denied -> rationale dialog shown on second denial
BitmapFactory.decodeStream returns null -> ChildUiState.Error('Could not decode image')
FCM payload JSON parse error -> log 'malformed_fcm_payload' warning, skip insert, no crash
reviewFlag=true in ClassificationResult -> parent sees 'Needs Human Review' badge

tasks.title: Write ClassificationSource contract tests with FakeClassificationSource
tasks.description: Write unit tests in android_client/app/src/test verifying ChildClassifyViewModel correctly handles all ClassificationSource return types via FakeClassificationSource. Test the interface contract: Success maps to SuccessText/SuccessImage, Failure(NetworkError) maps to Error, Failure(RateLimitError) maps to Error with appropriate message.
acceptance_criteria: FakeClassificationSource returns pre-configured results without network calls
Success(ClassificationResult) -> ChildUiState.SuccessText with correct label
Failure(NetworkError) -> ChildUiState.Error
Failure(RateLimitError) -> ChildUiState.Error with 'too many requests' message
All contract tests pass with Robolectric without requiring an emulator

tasks.title: Unit tests for ViewModels, SettingsRepository, and offline behavior
tasks.description: Write unit tests with Robolectric and MockWebServer covering: ChildClassifyViewModel offline behavior (MockWebServer closed -> Error state), SettingsViewModel save+testConnection flow, AlertRepository purgeOldDismissed() removes old rows, and image compression stays under 500ms. No emulator required.
acceptance_criteria: ChildClassifyViewModelOfflineTest: MockWebServer closed -> Error state emitted
SettingsViewModel: save() then testConnection() uses new URL
AlertRepository: purgeOldDismissed() removes rows with dismissedAt > 7 days
Image compression test: 3 image sizes, all compress in < 500ms
All tests run without a physical device or emulator

tasks.title: Instrumented integration tests for FCM-to-UI latency and camera permission flow
tasks.description: Write Android instrumented tests in androidTest/ covering: FCM message injection -> Room insert -> Dashboard UI update (measure latency), camera permission denial -> rationale dialog, and end-to-end classify -> result card display. These require an emulator or physical device with API 24+.
acceptance_criteria: ParentFcmToUiLatencyTest: inject FCM message -> Room insert -> Flow emit -> UI recompose, measure total < 2s
CameraPermissionFlowTest: deny camera -> no crash; second tap -> rationale dialog
ChildClassifyScreenTest: enter text -> classify -> ResultCard shows label
Tests target minSdk 24 and pass on an API 30+ emulator

tasks.title: Write android_client README covering both flavors, DI setup, and network security config
tasks.description: Write android_client/README.md documenting: child vs parent flavor differences, build commands for each APK, Hilt DI setup, network_security_config.xml cleartext HTTP rules, google-services.json placement for parent flavor, and how to run unit tests without an emulator. Include the package rename plan (com.dima.offensivehebrew -> com.shomer.client).
acceptance_criteria: README documents both gradle build commands: assembleChildRelease and assembleParentRelease
Network security config cleartext rules are documented with the LAN IP ranges
Package rename plan is documented with the recommended timing (before Meeting 5)
Hilt setup section mentions the AppModule.kt file and what it provides
